notes: Governing documents: Personnel Policy and Procedures Manual 1000.00 (applies to all employees; the Faculty Handbook's Leaves and Benefits policy, effective July 1, 2017, points to it for sick, family and medical, and parental leave) and the Faculty Handbook policies on Faculty Modified Duties and Extending the Tenure Review Period (both effective July 1, 2017). missing is false.

Version: the saved copy of Manual 1000.00 is a Wayback capture of 2016-01-17, before the reference period (2017-18); its sections carry their own dates (latest: 1025.00 and 1045.00 effective February 1, 2013). The HR summary page (Wayback 2018-11-21) cites the same sections 1025.00, 1030.00, 1045.00 and 1070.00 and restates their terms (six weeks of sick leave for recovery, 15 workdays of parental leave, 12 workweeks of FMLA, 240 hours of donated sick leave), so no change by the reference date is indicated; no version_uncertain flag set.

Summaries: 2018_00_link (HR leave page, undated, copy Nov 2018) and 2018_01_note (HR faculty options page, undated, copy March 2020, after the reference period). Neither adds a provision absent from the governing documents. 2018_01_note's 'Opt out of Stop-the-Clock Policy Change' describes an opt-out programme as a proposal, whereas the governing Faculty Handbook policy (effective July 1, 2017) already makes the extension automatic with an opt-out; the governing document is coded.

Not components: the Requested Extension of the Tenure Period (Handbook section 5) applies only to circumstances 'other than an event listed in Section 3', so a parent cannot use it for a birth or adoption. Military leave, jury and witness leave, public office leave, severe weather leave, training time, holidays, the EAP, moving expenses and the tuition waiver cannot be used for a birth. Compensatory time (Manual 915.00, not saved) is named only as a source of pay for maternity and parental leave. Workers' compensation is for work-related injury.

No employer-paid parental leave: every maternity and parental leave is paid only from the employee's own sick leave, annual leave (academic-year faculty accrue none), compensatory time or donated sick leave, or is unpaid (R1, R1b, R1d). The only employer-paid provision is Faculty Modified Duties (c11), relief without a reduction in pay, coded negotiated (see its flag).
Calendar: the FMD policy refers to 'the semester calendar'; the documents state the kind of term but not its length, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Cross-references not saved: MCA 49-2-310; MCA 2-18-606; MCA 2-18-618; Montana Operations Manual 3-0305, 3-0310, 3-0312, 3-0321, 3-0322, 3-0325, 3-0330; Montana University System (Board of Regents) Policies 708.1.1, 801.3, 801.5, 801.7.1, 801.14.1, 801.14.2, 803.2, 804.4, 940.13; MSU Faculty Handbook Sections 1200.00, 1211.00, 1232.00 and Appendix A; MSU Personnel Manual Section 915.00 (Overtime/Compensatory Time); 29 CFR Part 825; the Family Medical Leave Fact Sheet and Form; the Faculty and Staff Leave Request form (LeaveWithoutPay.pdf); the Donated Sick Leave Form and the Donated Sick Leave Pool pages; the ADVANCE website.

Chain, birth parent: maternity leave, six-week disability period on own sick or donated sick leave (c1), with the MCA 49-2-310 reasonable leave (c3) and FMLA 12 workweeks (c5) alongside from its start -> discretionary extension on annual leave, compensatory time or leave without pay (c2, no length); Faculty Modified Duties, up to one semester of relief (c11), also available with no order stated. Sick leave (c6) -> disability leave without pay (c8) once sick leave is exhausted.

Chain, non-birth parent: parental leave of up to 15 working days immediately after the birth (c4), with FMLA 12 workweeks (c5) alongside from its start; Faculty Modified Duties (c11), if the primary caregiver, also available with no order stated.
